detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

A bug in our code stopped some NKE clusters from being deleted. 🛠️

Only clusters with an HAProxy Ingress were affected: Cockpit returned an error and the cluster stayed. The cause was ours, a component name with different capitalisation in one place.

Live since late June, flagged by our monitoring on 3 August, fixed in production since 10 August. We didn't bill for clusters that kept running because of it. ✅

Questions? Ask our support.

#kubernetes #haproxy #devops #sre #nine
